title: The app catalog got a fresh check
summary:
A maintenance day: fresher app listings and README coverage for the previous day’s audio and text model news.

App metrics and health-check results were refreshed, updating Greenhouse ordering and listings, including Viralent and Aqua Application Programming Interface.

The README’s Latest News now includes the June 23 Stable Audio 3 entry, covering audio up to 380 seconds at 44.1 kHz stereo and audio-to-audio style transfer.

The same README update added the June 23 Mercury 2 entry, noting cached input and reasoning-token support, and cleared older entries to make room.
